top_tier1_launches.title: Pearl Launches Second Opinion 3D, Bringing FDA-Cleared CBCT Imaging AI to General Dentists for the First Time
top_tier1_launches.summary: Pearl launched Second Opinion 3D, making its FDA-cleared CBCT imaging AI available to general dentists in the US and Canada. The product adds embedded specialist radiology-report requests and automatic conversion of CBCT findings into insurance claim-ready documentation. AI-powered pathology detection is available in Canada and pending approval in additional markets.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: Pearl launched Second Opinion 3D, making its FDA-cleared CBCT imaging AI available to general dentists in the US and Canada.
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: A new 3D product that opens the general dentist CBCT market, backed by Pearl's unique 2D and 3D FDA clearance.

top_tier1_launches.title: Planet DDS Declares the Practice Management Era Over and Launches DentalOS®, the Dental Enterprise Platform for DSOs
top_tier1_launches.summary: Planet DDS launched DentalOS®, a new dental enterprise software platform designed to replace traditional practice management systems for DSOs and multi-location dental groups. The platform connects Denticon and Cloud 9 practice management systems on a single data layer, incorporating AI-powered enterprise tools including confirmation agents, clinical voice documentation, and revenue cycle management capabilities. The company, which already serves more than half of the largest 60 DSOs in North America across 14,500 practices, positions this launch as addressing the industry-wide shift from acquisition-driven growth to operational consolidation requiring enterprise-grade infrastructure.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: Planet DDS launched DentalOS®, a new dental enterprise software platform designed to replace traditional practice management systems for DSOs and multi-location dental groups.
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: Unifies Denticon and Cloud 9 on a single data layer with AI tools, repositioning from PMS to enterprise platform and deepening switching costs for DSOs.
top_tier1_launches.context_quote: Unifying practice management, imaging, payments, patient engagement, financing (CareCredit), and AI agents on one platform

top_tier1_launches.title: Pearl launches AI documentation tool
top_tier1_launches.summary: Pearl, a dental AI company, released Pearl Voice, an ambient tool that listens during patient visits and converts transcribed conversations into structured clinical notes, including SOAP notes and periodontal charts. The software includes over 30 procedure-specific templates and a voice dictation mode for perio charting.
top_tier1_launches.evidence_quote: Pearl, a dental AI company, released Pearl Voice, an ambient tool that listens during patient visits
top_tier1_launches.why_differentiated: A new product line for documentation that can be cross-sold into Pearl's installed base and sits outside radiology.
